purpose: Teach: フリーズ/プロトタイプ/ゲラ/内野/地場/からくり/ペンネーム/中高生

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験装置のフリーズに備えろ
lines.en: Ren — prepare for the experimental equipment freeze.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. No wasted words. Chin slightly lifted — this is important instruction, not a suggestion. Steady eye contact, brief pause after the name.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究プロトタイプを早期に作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll get the research prototype built ahead of schedule.
lines.style: Quick, affirming response. Slight nod on the 'yes.' Then lean forward slightly — showing eagerness to demonstrate readiness. Clipped pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文のゲラチェックを徹底しろ
lines.en: Ren — be thorough with the paper's galley proofs.
lines.style: Firm, expectant tone. Light stress on 'thorough' — this is where mistakes hide. Looking at him over the top of glasses if worn, or just that elevated-brow register. No room for cutting corners.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験室の内野的役割も果たします
lines.en: Yes. I'll take on fieldwork responsibilities in the lab too.
lines.style: Steady, almost dutiful. Not performing eagerness — just stating capacity. Small breath before the second sentence, showing he's already thinking ahead to the work. Even pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、地場の研究機関とも交流しろ
lines.en: Ren — also liaise with the local research institutions.
lines.style: Adding another layer of expectation. Voice stays level but this is a test of bandwidth. Slight pause after his name — waiting to see if Ren's shoulders tense. Matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文のからくりが見破られないよう正直に書きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll be honest and straightforward in the writing so there are no hidden inconsistencies.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, then a careful second thought. His voice steadies on 'honest' — this matters to him. He's making a small promise to himself and to Hiroshi. Measured, sincere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文ペンネームを使うのは慎重にしろ
lines.en: Ren — be careful about using a pen name for the paper.
lines.style: A warning, not a lecture. Quiet weight to this one. He's not accusing — he's protecting Ren from a mistake. Voice drops slightly at the end, like he's thinking of something Ren hasn't yet.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。中高生向けの科学講座にも貢献します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also contribute to science workshops for middle and high school students.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly softer than before. He's found his answer — giving back as a way to stay grounded. Voice settles into steadiness. This feels like a commitment he means.
